name: review-cycle
description: Automated multi-agent code review cycle. Spawns reviewers in parallel (plus Codex when available), applies fixes per CLAUDE.md policy, and admits a commit only when you asked for it and a reviewer saw exactly what it records.

enabled.title: Commit gate
enabled.description: Refuse a commit unless a reviewer saw what it records and you asked for it, and a push you did not ask for. Only you can change this, here in /config.
